story.title: The Unclaimed Tag
story.logline: A lost-and-found clerk discovers that the abandoned items in her warehouse possess lingering warmth, only to realize her own jacket is sitting in the unclaimed bin.
story.theme: Grief, memory, and the terror of being forgotten.
story.twist: The clerk isn't an employee helping lost souls; she died three years ago and is herself an unclaimed item waiting in limbo.
story.ending: A haunting realization that prompts the viewer to ponder if anyone is keeping their memory alive.

scenes.narration: I found my own apartment key sitting on the lost-and-found counter, glowing scorching hot under the flickering fluorescent lighting.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Close-up shot of a brass house key resting on a wooden counter, emitting a faint red thermal glow. 26-year-old Maya, dark hair in a messy ponytail with a neon pink streak, wearing a faded blue denim jacket over a grey hoodie, stares down in shock inside a dimly lit subterranean lost-and-found archive with towering metal shelves.
scenes.camera: Slow close-up zoom into the glowing key

scenes.narration: For three exhausting years, I’ve cataloged forgotten objects inside this basement archive, but nobody ever comes back to claim them.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Medium shot of 26-year-old Maya with dark ponytail and neon pink streak, wearing her faded blue denim jacket over a grey hoodie, walking through narrow aisles of a subterranean warehouse packed with shelves of old suitcases, umbrella stands, and boxed items.
scenes.camera: Tracking backward shot ahead of Maya

scenes.narration: Every lost item carries a physical pulse, a lingering hum of heat left behind by the person who held it last.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Close-up of Maya's hands in fingerless gloves touching a vintage leather handbag on a shelf; orange light ripples across the leather texture. Maya (26, pink-streaked ponytail, denim jacket over grey hoodie) is visible in profile.

scenes.narration: This morning, a silver pocket watch hummed so violently that its glass face shattered, pointing straight toward my timecard.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. A silver pocket watch exploding its glass crystal on a metal table. In the background, Maya (26, pink streak in ponytail, denim jacket) flinches back inside the dark basement archive.

scenes.narration: I flipped through the thick leather logbook to report the accident, only to find my own handwriting logging tomorrow’s inventory.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Over-the-shoulder shot looking down at an ancient leather-bound ledger. Maya's hands turn pages covered in neat handwriting dated tomorrow. Maya (26, dark ponytail with pink streak) stands in the dimly lit basement archive.

scenes.narration: Driven by sudden panic, I sprinted down aisle nine, where rows of towering shelves held glowing coats, rings, and abandoned keys.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Wide low-angle shot looking down a dark aisle of metal shelves glowing with faint thermal lights. Maya (26, ponytail with pink streak, blue denim jacket) runs down the center corridor away from camera.

scenes.narration: At the end of the aisle sat a solitary wooden crate labeled with my full name and today’s precise date.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Medium shot of a heavy oak box on a low shelf, stencil-printed with bold black text reading MAYA L. - OCT 24. Maya (26, pink streak, blue denim jacket over grey hoodie) kneels slowly in front of it in the subterranean archive.
scenes.camera: Slow tilt down to the crate

scenes.narration: Inside lay my favourite denim jacket, now ice-cold, tagged with a metal label that marked me as completely unclaimed.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. High angle shot looking into the wooden crate. Inside is an identical faded blue denim jacket, covered in frost, with a shiny steel toe-tag reading UNCLAIMED. Maya (26, pink streak ponytail) reaches out with trembling hands.

scenes.narration: I was never the clerk saving forgotten lives; I was the lost item, waiting three empty years for someone to remember.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Medium shot of Maya (26, ponytail with neon pink streak, denim jacket) looking directly into camera as her body begins to turn translucent, revealing dusty warehouse shelves behind her.

scenes.narration: When you touch your warm apartment key tonight, remember that someone might still be waiting in the dark for you.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame. Cinematic final shot of an empty warehouse aisle where Maya stood, her brass key sitting alone on the cold floor, still pulsing with a soft crimson glow.

caption.hook: Her own jacket was in the bin.
caption.title: The Unclaimed Tag
caption.caption: She spent years cataloging the warmth of other people's memories, never realizing her own time had already run out. How do you let go when you are the forgotten one?
